Callout.Name: Solicitation Reported
Callout.Message: Solicitation reported on a street corner.
Callout.Advisory: Fesuspect on foot, no violence, businesses complaining.

Script.Line: I am waiting for somebody. That is all I am doing.
I have been on this corner twenty minutes and I have not spoken to a soul.
You have got nothing. Everybody on this street knows it.

Lines.Approach: Businesses have had enough. Nobody is in danger, they just want it dealt with.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
